The '''Zareca String''' was an ancient vertical [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperjump]] from the [[Rishi system/Legends|Rishi system]] to the [[Kamino system/Legends|Kamino system]]. The route was charted during the [[Subterra Period]] and was accessible via [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. The Zareca String had a line of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] suspended in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. These remote intermediate [[Star system/Legends|systems]] served mainly as supply depots and refuelling stations. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] navigated the Zareca String during his quest to locate the lost planet of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="Atlas" />
